flight_modes.purpose: Emergency manual control; direct RC passthrough to ailerons and V-tail, bypassing autopilot stabilization

flight_modes.transition_dependency: Fixed-Wing Flight Only (Cannot be used in hover)
flight_modes.failsafe_behavior: Switch to FBWA or RTL on RC loss

flight_modes.purpose: Fly-By-Wire A; stabilized fixed-wing forward transit with roll/pitch angle limits
flight_modes.propulsion_authority: Cruise Pusher Motor active (VTOL rotors assist if Q_ASSIST_SPEED triggered)
flight_modes.control_surface_authority: Autopilot attitude loop driving Ailerons & V-tail
flight_modes.transition_dependency: Entered automatically upon outbound transition completion
flight_modes.failsafe_behavior: Level wings and climb if airspeed low; failsafe to RTL on link loss
flight_modes.notes: Primary manual transit mode for fixed-wing flight

flight_modes.purpose: QuadPlane manual attitude stabilization for VTOL hover testing
flight_modes.propulsion_authority: 4x VTOL Lift Motors active (Pusher motor disabled)
flight_modes.control_surface_authority: Surfaces active but secondary to rotor differential thrust
flight_modes.failsafe_behavior: Immediate throttle cut on disarm / disarm on ground

flight_modes.purpose: QuadPlane altitude-hold hover with barometric vertical rate control
flight_modes.propulsion_authority: 4x VTOL Lift Motors active (Pusher motor idle)
flight_modes.failsafe_behavior: Descend at Land Speed (1.5 m/s) on loss of link

flight_modes.purpose: QuadPlane GPS position-hold and altitude-hold hover
flight_modes.failsafe_behavior: QRTL on link loss or battery low
flight_modes.notes: Requires 3D GNSS lock and healthy EKF3 status

flight_modes.purpose: QuadPlane Return-To-Launch with automated inbound transition and VTOL landing
flight_modes.propulsion_authority: Cruise Motor to return, then 4x Lift Motors for hover landing
flight_modes.control_surface_authority: Active during transit; deactivated in final descent
flight_modes.transition_dependency: Automated inbound transition at return coordinate
flight_modes.failsafe_behavior: Emergency vertical landing at current position if battery critical

flight_modes.purpose: Fully autonomous waypoint mission execution across all 10 operational states

flight_modes.transition_dependency: Autonomous dual-direction transitions triggered by DO_VTOL_TRANSITION

mission_states.transition_condition: Pre-arm checks passed, RTK fix acquired, arm command received
mission_states.exit_condition: Autopilot armed and mission start command confirmed
mission_states.abort_condition: Any sensor failure, pre-arm warning, or RC link failure

mission_states.exit_condition: Aircraft lifts off ground cleanly and achieves 5m AGL
mission_states.abort_condition: Excessive roll/pitch tip-over angle (>15 deg) or motor desync
Vertical rate < 1.0 m/s or high motor saturation (>95%)
mission_states.failsafe_action: Immediate transition to QLAND vertical descent

mission_states.transition_condition: Airspeed accelerates from 0 to 18.06 m/s (stall speed threshold)
mission_states.exit_condition: Airspeed >= ARSPD_FBW_MIN (18.06 m/s) and duration >= Q_TRANSITION_MS (18s)
mission_states.abort_condition: Airspeed fails to reach 18 m/s within Q_TRANS_FAIL (1.5s timeout / assumption)
mission_states.failsafe_action: Throttle cut to pusher, return to QHOVER / QLOITER

mission_states.transition_condition: Forward fixed-wing cruise transit along survey track (20.8 m/s)
mission_states.exit_condition: Survey boundary reached or waypoint sequence completed
mission_states.failsafe_action: Automatic Q_ASSIST lift motor spin-up or RTL failsafe

mission_states.exit_condition: Mapping coordinates finished or battery reserve <= 25%
mission_states.abort_condition: Loss of RTK fix or telemetry link failure

mission_states.transition_condition: Home landing coordinate reached; decelerating from 20.8 m/s to 0 m/s
mission_states.exit_condition: Airspeed < 5.0 m/s, lift rotors fully supporting aircraft weight
mission_states.abort_condition: Motor spool-up failure or attitude instability (>25 deg pitch/roll)
mission_states.failsafe_action: Deploy ballistic parachute or glide to emergency landing

mission_states.transition_condition: Descent from 50m to 3m AGL at 1.5 m/s
mission_states.abort_condition: Ground station visual obstruction or lateral drift > 2m
mission_states.failsafe_action: Hold altitude in QLOITER and alert ground station

mission_states.exit_condition: Landing detector triggers (zero vertical rate, motor idle)

mission_states.transition_condition: Motors disarmed on ground, flight logs closed

failsafes.fallback_mode: QRTL (Climb to RTL altitude, return to home, and VTOL land)
failsafes.verification_method: Ground bench RC transmitter power-down simulation

failsafes.fallback_mode: Continue pre-loaded autonomous mission; execute QRTL if battery low
failsafes.verification_method: Bench disconnection of SiK 915MHz GCS modem

failsafes.detection_mechanism: Matek PDB-HEX analog voltage/current monitoring on POWER1
failsafes.verification_method: Simulated voltage sag injection via programmable bench DC supply
failsafes.notes: Initiates return before battery depletion prevents hover recovery

failsafes.detection_mechanism: Matek PDB-HEX analog voltage monitoring on POWER1
failsafes.fallback_mode: Immediate vertical descent at current position (BATT_FS_CRT_ACT = 1: Land)
failsafes.verification_method: DC bench power step-down test to 20.4V
failsafes.notes: Prevents cell over-discharge and total power cutout in flight

failsafes.failure_name: GNSS / RTK Fix Loss or GPS Glitch
failsafes.detection_mechanism: EKF3 innovation threshold check; loss of 3D fix flags (GPS_GLITCH_RADIUS)
failsafes.fallback_mode: Dead-reckoning navigation using synthetic wind, altitude hold via QHOVER
failsafes.verification_method: GNSS antenna RF shielding / simulated GPS signal loss
failsafes.notes: Drift rate depends on compass and pitot accuracy (CONFIGURATION_SUPPORTED)

failsafes.detection_mechanism: EK3 core health flags / lane switching failure
failsafes.notes: Switches to secondary/tertiary IMU core before declaring failure

failsafes.failure_name: Airspeed Sensor Clogging or I2C Failure
failsafes.detection_mechanism: Pitot dynamic pressure anomaly check vs GPS groundspeed (ARSPD_FAIL_ACTION)
failsafes.fallback_mode: Failover to synthetic airspeed estimation (EKF3 groundspeed + wind matrix +15% margin)
failsafes.notes: Software-supported fallback; stall margin under gust conditions remains unproven in flight

failsafes.detection_mechanism: EKF3 magnetic field anomaly detection / yaw innovation check
failsafes.verification_method: Bench magnetic field disturbance test with neodymium magnet
failsafes.notes: High-speed fixed-wing flight can navigate without magnetometer

failsafes.detection_mechanism: Airspeed decay below Q_ASSIST_SPEED (18.0 m/s) despite 100% cruise throttle
failsafes.fallback_mode: Q_ASSIST automatic VTOL lift rotor spool-up; abort cruise and enter QRTL hover landing
failsafes.verification_method: In-flight throttle cut simulation in SITL / bench test
failsafes.notes: Gliding back-transition corridor supported by software configuration (CONFIGURATION_SUPPORTED)

failsafes.failure_name: Cruise ESC Failure / Loss of Throttle Signal
failsafes.detection_mechanism: Zero forward acceleration detected during cruise phase
failsafes.fallback_mode: Autonomous switch to VTOL lift propulsion and QRTL return
failsafes.verification_method: Signal disconnect test to PWM Output 5
failsafes.notes: Identical aerodynamic recovery behavior to Cruise Motor Flameout

failsafes.detection_mechanism: High roll/pitch rate acceleration with saturated motor output on opposite quadrant
failsafes.fallback_mode: Pure hover unmaintainable on 4-rotor frame; command forward pitch to gain wing lift if altitude permits, or deploy parachute
failsafes.notes: Legitimately DEFERRED per Phase 9 (HOVER_ENGINE_OUT). Pure hover with 1 out of 4 lift rotors cannot maintain static attitude.

failsafes.detection_mechanism: Attitude error accumulation despite trim command saturation
failsafes.fallback_mode: Trim remaining surfaces and transition to VTOL hover where rotor differential thrust dominates
failsafes.notes: Cross-control trim authority under jammed servo remains DEFERRED (AERO_JAM_TRIM in Phase 9)

failsafes.fallback_mode: STM32F100 IOMCU coprocessor takes over PWM outputs, commanding neutral surfaces and motor idle
failsafes.verification_method: Watchdog reset injection via software test build
failsafes.notes: Architectural hardware safety feature of Holybro Pixhawk 6X

failsafes.detection_mechanism: Heartbeat timeout on TELEM2 serial UART (>3.0s)
failsafes.fallback_mode: Autonomous flight execution continues uninterrupted; vision/payload tasks disabled
failsafes.verification_method: SBC power-down test during bench telemetry monitoring
failsafes.notes: Hardware isolation verified in Phase 9 (Dedicated 5V 3A BEC prevents electrical cross-talk)

failsafes.failure_name: PDB Total Main Bus Short Circuit
failsafes.detection_mechanism: Instantaneous loss of primary 22.2V bus voltage
failsafes.fallback_mode: Mechanical spring-loaded or pyrotechnic ballistic parachute recovery
failsafes.notes: Classified as NOT_ANALYZED in Phase 9 FMEA-11; parachute subsystem integration required

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Apply 6S LiPo power via XT90-S; measure 5.0V regulated avionics bus voltage under idle and boot load.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: POWER1 VCC reads 5.05V +/- 0.1V; status LEDs indicate clean boot without brownout reset.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Battery and Matek PDB-HEX connected with verified polarity.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Query ArduPilot MAVLink device table via Mission Planner / QGroundControl.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: F9P GNSS, IST8310 compass, MS4525 airspeed, dual barometers, and 3x IMUs detected on I2C/SPI/CAN.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Pixhawk powered up and connected to GCS via USB or SiK radio.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Position aircraft in open sky; verify satellite constellation count and RTK carrier phase lock.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Satellite count >= 16, HDOP <= 0.8, 3D DGPS or RTK Fixed status verified.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Outdoor sky visibility; RTK correction stream active.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Perform 360-degree yaw rotation on ground; compare reported heading against surveyed magnetic bearing.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Reported heading within +/- 2.5 degrees of true bearing; zero magnetic anomaly warning.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Cover pitot probe to verify zero drift; gently blow into pitot tube to test dynamic pressure response.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Zero airspeed reads < 1.0 m/s; positive velocity spike (>15 m/s) cleanly recorded without I2C error.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Pneumatic silicone tubes securely clamped with zero air leak.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.test_name: RC Pilot Control Link & Range Check
ground_test_checklist.procedure: Execute low-power RF range test at 30m; verify full stick deflection on Channels 1-4 and flight mode switch.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Link quality (LQ) = 100%, 0 lost frames, jitter < 2us, mode switch cycles correctly.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Transmitter and Crossfire Nano RX bound and calibrated.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Stream high-rate telemetry over 915MHz SiK radio; send parameter download and command pulse.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: 57600 baud link maintains >95% packet success rate with CTS/RTS hardware flow control active.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Antennas vertically polarized with adequate physical separation.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Execute ArduPilot Motor Test dialog on GCS at 5% throttle sequentially for M1, M2, M3, M4, M5.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Motor 1 (FL), Motor 2 (FR), Motor 3 (RL), Motor 4 (RR), and Motor 5 (Pusher) spin in correct sequence.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Propellers REMOVED from all 5 motors for bench safety.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Physically verify shaft rotation direction against nominal Quad-X and pusher requirements.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: M1 spins CW, M2 spins CCW, M3 spins CCW, M4 spins CW, M5 spins CW (pusher); if inverted, swap phase leads or invert DShot.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Propellers REMOVED; tactile or high-speed visual verification.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Test rapid throttle steps (0% -> 25% -> 50% -> 0%) via GCS motor test dialog.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Sub-millisecond throttle tracking without desync, stuttering, or ESC overheating.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Propellers REMOVED; DC bench supply current limited to 20A.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Command right roll stick input; observe left and right aileron trailing edge deflections.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Right aileron deflects UP, Left aileron deflects DOWN; full stick produces +/- 20 degrees deflection.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Mechanical servo pushrod linkages connected and mechanically centered.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Command nose-up elevator stick input; observe left and right ruddervator deflections on inverted V-tail.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Both surfaces deflect trailing edge UP/OUTWARD to generate nose-up pitching moment.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: V-tail linkages connected and neutral trim verified.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Command pure yaw right stick input; verify differential surface deflection on V-tail.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Surfaces deflect differentially to produce positive aerodynamic yaw moment without parasitic pitch.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: GROUND-TEST-12 passed; mixer gains set in ArduPilot.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.test_name: Analog Battery Monitor Voltage & Current Scaling
ground_test_checklist.procedure: Measure battery terminal voltage with calibrated digital multimeter; draw 10A through dummy load.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Autopilot reported voltage matches multimeter within +/- 0.05V; current matches within +/- 0.2A.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Calibrated external DMM and DC load bank.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Turn off RC transmitter while armed in QHOVER mode; monitor autopilot mode change.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Autopilot immediately triggers THR_FAILSAFE and transitions to QRTL within 1.5s.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Propellers REMOVED; motors disarmed before physical approach.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.test_name: Pre-Arm Safety Checks & Arming / Disarming Sequence
ground_test_checklist.procedure: Attempt arming with safety switch pressed, then attempt arming with disconnected airspeed tube.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Clean arming when all sensors healthy; arming blocked with descriptive pre-arm error when airspeed missing.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: ARMING_CHECK parameter set to 1 (All checks active).
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Simulate 20 m/s dynamic pressure into pitot using regulated pneumatic source while in AUTO mode.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Pusher motor spools up, duration timer counts 18s, lift rotors smoothly spool down and stop.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: Pneumatic test rig connected to pitot probe; props REMOVED.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

ground_test_checklist.procedure: Arm aircraft on bench for 60 seconds; disarm, extract `.bin` dataflash log via MAVLink, and inspect.
ground_test_checklist.expected_result: Log contains complete ATT, CTUN, QTUN, IMU, NKF1, BAT, and MOT message series with 0 dropouts.
ground_test_checklist.prerequisite: High-speed Class 10 industrial micro-SD card formatted FAT32.
ground_test_checklist.notes: Physical execution required prior to flight clearance

hardware_reconciliation.impact_analysis: Protocol Impact: Spedix GS40A natively supports DShot600 (sub-millisecond digital throttle without calibration). T-Motor AIR 40A only supports Fast PWM up to 600Hz; if AIR 40A were used, MOT_PWM_TYPE=6 (DShot600) would fail. Mass Impact: 4x Spedix GS40A weigh 0.048 kg total; 4x AIR 40A weigh 0.140 kg total (+92 g delta). Catalog Status: T-Motor AIR 40A is NOT in Phase 8 commercial product catalog.
hardware_reconciliation.recommendation: HARDWARE_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: Maintain Phase 8 Spedix GS40A (`BOM-003`) as the authoritative commercial selection to preserve DShot600 digital protocol and mass budget. Harmonize Phase 9 integration documentation to remove uncataloged 'T-Motor AIR 40A' references.

hardware_reconciliation.impact_analysis: Protocol Impact: Both ESCs support standard PWM. Skywalker V2 includes integrated 5V/5A BEC. Mass Impact: Skywalker V2 weighs 0.042 kg; FlyFun 40A weighs 0.040 kg (-2 g delta). Catalog Status: FlyFun 40A V5 is NOT registered in Phase 8 commercial catalog.
hardware_reconciliation.recommendation: HARDWARE_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: Maintain Phase 8 Hobbywing Skywalker 40A V2 (`BOM-005`) as the authoritative commercial selection. Update Phase 9 integration documentation.

hardware_reconciliation.phase8_bom_selection: Included in Phase 5 airframe ledger & Phase 8 LRUs
hardware_reconciliation.impact_analysis: Mass Verification: Wiring harness (0.260 kg) was pre-allocated in Phase 5 structural mass ledger. XT90-S and 5V BEC represent +50 g integration hardware accounted for in the Phase 9 mass reconciliation (+81 g hardware delta / +1.03% MTOW, within 150g threshold). No double-counting or omission detected.
hardware_reconciliation.recommendation: Integration hardware accounting verified without discrepancy.
